---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or new client-side tool for ZenoDeck
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: 'enhancement'
assignees: ''
---

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem or workflow bottleneck is (e.g. "I often need to...").

**Describe the Solution You'd Like**
A clear description of the new tool, conversion preset, or feature you envision.

**Client-Side / On-Device Feasibility**
- [ ] This feature runs 100% client-side (WebAssembly, Web Audio API, WebCodecs, or browser-native API)
- [ ] Zero user file data is transmitted to external servers or cloud services

**Alternative Approaches Considered**
Describe any alternative tools or workflows you have used or considered.

**Additional Context / Mockups**
Add any diagrams, screenshots, or sample command-line parameters (e.g., FFmpeg filter flags) to help illustrate your idea.
